# Source

Public-source adaptations with one injected E3011 defect.
This is not an upstream regression and not a naturally occurring defect.

- cJSON 1.7.19, CJSON.c: parse_string, print_string_ptr and bounded printbuffer.
  Adapted to caller-owned buffers, ASCII strings, unsigned integers and arrays.
- zlib 1.3.2, adler32.c, crc32.c and trees.c: block sums, reflected CRC,
  code-length counts, canonical codes and reversed bit order.
- Zstandard 1.5.7, lib/compress/hist.c and lib/common/xxhash.h:
  striped symbol counting and the unsigned XXH32 tail recurrence.
- Zstandard 1.5.7, lib/compress/zstd_fast.c: greedy match/sequence split.
  The bounded adaptation uses a linear search, not the upstream hash table.

The view, buffers, record format, public fingerprint and hidden driver are
corpus scaffolding. Every codec module contributes to the fingerprint.
The hidden driver uses 16 seeds, including full-width unsigned boundaries.
The command consumes 32 bytes and returns that count. It does not report the
fingerprint. The codec-record workload changes the generated byte pattern.
All twelve items share this module bundle. They are not twelve independent
upstream programs. Licenses are retained in the corpus root.
